current.text: Brooklyn drafted a point guard with the 6th pick and added Julius Randle in a trade.
Experts project him as a bench rotation player, not a starter. The projected starting guards are Mikel Brown Jr. and Egor Demin.
He is expected to handle the ball less because Randle will handle it a lot. He will have to fight for bench ball-handling minutes.
Experts call him a draft loser with no real shot at fantasy value this season.

tags.name: role down
tags.detail: Projected bench player after starting much of last season. He will handle the ball less with Randle and a pick-6 point guard on the roster.

tags.name: minutes competition
tags.detail: He competes for bench ball-handling minutes after Brooklyn drafted a point guard at pick 6.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 380, ESPN rank 259), and he was not drafted in our league last season. With only 144 players drafted, he should not be on any auction list. His projected line of about 39% FG on 9 shots and 2.3 turnovers, with only 4.0 assists, hurts more than it helps in 9-cat. Early in the season, only check whether a guard injury moves him back into real ball-handling minutes. Otherwise leave him on waivers.
